instruction: Implement retry.py: a `with_retry(fn, tries=4, base=0.1)` helper that calls fn, on exception sleeps base*2**i seconds (i=0..), and returns fn()'s result on success or re-raises after the last try. flaky.py fails twice then succeeds — running retry.py must print 'ok' and take >= 0.6s of sleeps (log each sleep to sleeps.txt, one delay per line).

grader.script: python3 retry.py | grep -qx ok && python3 -c "d=[float(l) for l in open('sleeps.txt')]; assert len(d)==2 and abs(d[0]-0.1)<1e-6 and abs(d[1]-0.2)<1e-6"
